_comment: CLOSED search config. Byte-for-byte the configuration used for every peptide_q number in
README.md and docs/. It previously lived only at /path/to/scratch/bench/sage_deiso.json,
untracked -- a reproducibility hole in the single file that DEFINES the project's metric.
The `fasta` path is rewritten by open_bench.py at run time; everything else is fixed.
Note what this config CANNOT see: precursor_tol is +-25 ppm, so any mass shift larger than
that is invisible. A charge error fabricates dM = (z'-z)(m/z - 1.00728), i.e. hundreds of Da.
Those PSMs simply do not appear -- which is why closed search cannot score the failure mode
